item.title: Megyn Kelly’s viral reaction to trans woman Giselle Byrd joining the Massachusetts Commission on the Women’s status sparks big debate
item.description: Giselle Byrd, a Black trans woman, has been appointed to the Massachusetts Commission on the Status of Women, sparking controversy. Megyn Kelly's online comment, "Men make the best women, we all know that," drew widespread criticism, with the commission deeming it hurtful. The Massachusetts Family Institute also voiced opposition, questioning the state's decision.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Trump’s Gaza peace plan: UNSC approves US-drafted resolution; Hamas rejects proposal
item.description: The US-led Gaza peace proposal has gained the approval of the UN Security Council, which will now deploy an International Stabilisation Force to manage demilitarization efforts and deliver humanitarian aid. Despite the backing, both Russia and China chose to abstain, while Hamas dismissed the resolution, calling it a violation of their autonomy and an affront to groups resisting outside influence.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Candace Owens sparks chaos with new Britney Spears trafficking claim as Lou Taylor link trends after Kim Kardashian video
item.description: Britney Spears shared a heartwarming Instagram video with Kim and Khloé Kardashian, sparking viral attention. Simultaneously, Candace Owens leveled serious accusations on her podcast, alleging Lou Taylor's manipulative control over Britney and other stars, citing an insider email and historical patterns of financial and media exploitation. Owens' claims, though unproven, have ignited significant discussion.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: France agrees to sell up to 100 fighter jets to Ukraine
item.description: France has pledged to sell up to 100 Rafale fighter jets and other defense equipment to Ukraine, signaling European resolve to counter long-term Russian threats. This historic agreement, extending to 2035, aims to bolster Ukraine's sovereignty and foster closer defense industry ties between the nations.

item.title: Death penalty for Hasina, Dhaka wants her back
item.description: Former Bangladesh PM Sheikh Hasina was sentenced to death in absentia for the 2024 student crackdown, a verdict she called a foregone conclusion. India responded cautiously, acknowledging the verdict and reiterating its commitment to Bangladesh's peace and stability, while remaining non-committal on extradition requests.
item.dc:creator: Sachin Parashar

item.title: Influencer Lauren Loveless marries Nikolaus Young and shares sweet vows in a touching coastal ceremony
item.description: Influencer Lauren Loveless, 26, and Nikolaus Young, 25, celebrated their union at a stunning wedding on Kiawah Island. The couple, high school sweethearts, shared heartfelt vows before 150 guests, including notable social media personalities. The event featured a live painter, a grand cake, and a memorable slumber party kick-off, culminating in a joyous celebration of their lifelong bond.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Who Is Marco Acortes? The mystery man behind viral 2013 coronavirus tweet everyone is talking about
item.description: An obscure tweet from 2013 by online creator Marco Acortes, stating "Corona virus….its coming," gained widespread attention in 2020 when COVID-19 emerged. The post, which has not been edited, resurfaced again in 2025, sparking speculation about Acortes's prescience. He has since ceased all social media activity, leaving his current whereabouts and the inspiration behind the tweet a mystery.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: QTCinderella faces backlash as Asmongold and Tectone question fairness of the streamer awards
item.description: Streamer QTCinderella faces backlash for explaining 'problematic' streamers' lack of award nominations by citing audience engagement. Prominent creators like Asmongold and Tectone dispute this, alleging financial interests and favoritism influence the event. This controversy reignites debates on transparency and fairness within the streaming community's award system, drawing even more public attention today.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: Did FBI remove Trump’s name from Epstein files? Report claims review of 100,000 documents, 300GB of evidence
item.description: In a recent twist, a report has emerged indicating that Donald Trump's name may have been omitted from the FBI's files on Jeffrey Epstein, igniting a fresh wave of debate. Initially downplaying the gravity of the situation, Trump has now pivoted, calling on House Republicans to unveil the documents in a bid for transparency.

item.title: QTCinderella reveals the real reason some streamers don’t get nominated
item.description: QTCinderella explains why some streamers are not nominated for the Streamer Awards. She states that "problematic" creators are not deliberately excluded. Instead, their audiences often do not participate in the nomination and voting process. This lack of engagement leads to a natural disadvantage for these streamers. The system relies heavily on fan participation to determine nominees.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: Misogynistic hate mob targets QTCinderella amid Streamer Awards controversy — Here’s what happened
item.description: QTCinderella is facing online criticism regarding her Streamer Awards show. Allegations of unfair influence have surfaced, with hate groups amplifying the controversy. This has led to a significant backlash, causing emotional distress for the event's founder. The situation highlights ongoing issues of gender-based harassment in the streaming community and the need for better platform protections for creators.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: Probe reveals Trump shooter Thomas Crooks’s links to ‘furry’ porn; MAGA says ‘kid was programmed’ to kill president
item.description: Emerging revelations about Thomas Crooks, the suspect in the alleged Trump shooting, showcase a dual life dominated by 'furry' artwork and extremist dialogues. Investigators have traced anonymous profiles tied to niche cartoon fetish content and chilling violent discourse.

item.title: 'Don't want anything to happen to Kash Patel's girlfriend': Congressman reacts to Alexis Wilkins' 'SWAT security'
item.description: Kash Patel came under severe criticism after a report claimed that his girlfriend Alexis Wilkins has an elite SWAT team for her security in Nashville. item.title: UAE: How the 'Ghaith 6' exhibition supports 6,000 low-income families in Sharjah
item.description: Sharjah's Ghaith 6 charitable exhibition at Expo Al Dhaid offers low-income families brand-new essentials at symbolic prices and free medical screenings. Launched by the Sharjah Charity Association, the event supports thousands of families with dignity, access to goods, and practical health services, fostering long-term community well-being.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'Terrible outcome for two families': Indian-origin woman, 8 months pregnant, killed by speeding BMW in Sydney, teen driver denied bail
item.description: Tragedy struck in Sydney as 33-year-old Samanvitha Dhareshwar, eight months pregnant, and her unborn child died in a car crash. A speeding BMW rear-ended a Kia, pushing it into the pedestrians. The 19-year-old BMW driver, Aaron Papazoglu, faces serious charges, with bail denied due to the incident's gravity.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘Those who want to end H-1Bs will make America last’: MAGA commentator defends Trump’s pro-immigrant stance
item.description: In a recent commentary, Bill Mitchell, a noted voice in the MAGA community, advised Trump supporters to reconsider their rigid views on H-1B visas. He emphasized that a hardline approach could jeopardize the United States' position as a leader in technology.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: What really happened in the final minutes of the Trainwreck-Ricoy Rust event? Fans enraged over Kick co-owner’s controversial decision
item.description: Kick co-owner Tyler "Trainwreck" Niknam faces backlash for allegedly manipulating his recent Rust event. Accusations of a rigged finale, a prior alliance with Ricoy, and biased rule changes have led to community outrage. Fans question the integrity of Kick's streams after Ricoy was declared the sole winner despite a tribunal's decision.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk
